transkript.t: These are the top four cloud plugins that changed my life as a cloud user.
Number one is Mark It Down by Microsoft. It turns any file into clean text that
cloud can read in seconds. It can do this for PDFs, Word docs, Excel sheets,
PowerPoints, and even images. This is not only going to let cloud read through all of
your stuff faster, but once you install this plugin it is going to burn through way less
tokens. And this thing is legit because Microsoft built it and it is completely free.
Number two is the last 30 days plugin. Normally whenever you ask cloud a question
or wanted to pull a specific piece of information it's basically just googling it.
But with the last 30 days plugin this lets cloud search through Reddit,
X, YouTube, Hacker News, and other top news sources to see exactly what people are saying
about your topic over the last 30 days. This is perfect to brief you before meetings,
a product launch, or for your next piece of content. Number three is Agent Reach. On its own
there are a lot of different platforms and applications that cloud cannot access. But
Agent Reach gives access to almost all these things. It can look at platforms like X,
Reddit, YouTube, and GitHub and you only have to install this once and then it can do this
completely for free. Number four is Prompt Motion. If you want cloud to make animations like
this, Prompt Motion lets cloud do exactly that. It is a complete library of motion videos
that are made with cloud and every single graphic comes with a prompt or a skill that
cloud can use to recreate it. So all that you have to do is find a graphic that you like and
then cloud can recreate it in your style. If you want the one prompt that you can give
to your cloud to install all four of these free plugins plus a guide on how and when to
use each one inside of cloud, comment plugin and I'll send it to you.
